snippet.title: Turkey vs USA in Kickabout for iPad
snippet.description: This match was recorded at the Museum of Art and Digital Entertainment during their Indie Showcase. It features Kickabout for iPad and iPhone, my new 1 and 2 player table football game; designed for touch control from day one. If you like the look of it, get it for free on iOS using the link in my bio or search "Kickabout" on the App Store.
